comment: Zed tool collections. Every package is a nixpkgs attribute path in Zed's pinned package set; the `registry` flake check fails if one is missing. Tools are for authorised assessment, learning and defence of systems you own or have permission to test. Collections contain only freely licensed packages; proprietary tools (for example volatility3) can be installed individually once nix.allowUnfree is enabled.

collections.title: Network analysis
collections.description: Capture, inspect and map network traffic and hosts.

collections.title: Web application assessment
collections.description: Proxies and scanners for testing web applications you are authorised to assess.

collections.title: Digital forensics
collections.description: Disk, file-system and memory analysis and data recovery.

collections.title: Password auditing
collections.description: Test the strength of password hashes you are responsible for.

collections.title: Cryptography
collections.description: Encryption, signing and key management tools.

collections.title: Incident response and hardening
collections.description: Audit, scan and triage systems you administer.

collections.title: Wireless analysis
collections.description: Survey and audit Wi-Fi networks you own or are authorised to test.
